top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling (Buchwald, Hartwig) is a general method whose ligand-driven design made aryl amine synthesis routine, with decades of independent confirmation and heavy use in medicinal and process chemistry; attribution to two names is clean. Pairing it with Liu alone for base editing, a defined deaminase chemistry distinct from RNA-guided cleavage, adds the one achievement most members share. The main risk is the 2010 Pd cross-coupling prize, which I judge to cover a different bond-forming problem.
recusal_note: No recusal needed; I disclose that B054 is in my own field of synthetic methodology, and Lund colleagues Linke and Sparr have no tie to any credited name.
